preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: Prepare the mineral-medium base with the source-specific mineral inputs;
    add the vitamins separately after heat sterilization.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH if specified in original formulation
- step_number: 3
  action: HEAT
  description: Heat-sterilize the mineral medium at 120 C before adding the filter-sterilized
    vitamins. The inspected source passage does not specify hold time or pressure.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: Add the filter-sterilized vitamins after heat sterilization, at the
    source-stated final vitamin concentrations. Filtration pore size and addition
    temperature are not specified.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: Prepare the mineral-medium base with the source-specific mineral inputs;
    add the vitamins separately after heat sterilization.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH if specified in original formulation
- step_number: 3
  action: HEAT
  description: Heat-sterilize the mineral medium at 120 C before adding the filter-sterilized
    vitamins. The inspected source passage does not specify hold time or pressure.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: Add the filter-sterilized vitamins after heat sterilization, at the
    source-stated final vitamin concentrations. Filtration pore size and addition
    temperature are not specified.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: Prepare the mineral-medium base with the source-specific mineral inputs;
    add the vitamins separately after heat sterilization.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH if specified in original formulation
- step_number: 3
  action: HEAT
  description: Heat-sterilize the mineral medium at 120 C before adding the filter-sterilized
    vitamins. The inspected source passage does not specify hold time or pressure.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: Add the filter-sterilized vitamins after heat sterilization, at the
    source-stated final vitamin concentrations. Filtration pore size and addition
    temperature are not specified.

- step_number: 1
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: Prepare the mineral-medium base with the source-specific mineral inputs;
    add the vitamins separately after heat sterilization.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH if specified in original formulation
- step_number: 3
  action: HEAT
  description: Heat-sterilize the mineral medium at 120 C before adding the filter-sterilized
    vitamins. The inspected source passage does not specify hold time or pressure.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: Add the filter-sterilized vitamins after heat sterilization, at the
    source-stated final vitamin concentrations. Filtration pore size and addition
    temperature are not specified.
